name: Wugtrio
description: Wugtrio, the Garden Eel Pokémon, and the evolved form of Wiglett. A Water type.
pokedex_entries: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.
